value.rationale: Ranks of square-zero elements of the derivation algebra provide a natural invariant of finite Heisenberg Lie algebras. The exact all-rank census includes a nontrivial rank increase caused by central functionals and a full positive discrete limiting corank law, including fields of characteristic two. This is a complete uniform family calculation, not a restatement of the previously known symmetric-matrix count.
